title: 第17章 爱上一位无法触及的存在第18章 傲视天下无拘无束逍遥一生
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“侄子是怎么走的……”忆无情看向自家师兄，严肃道。
他要知道自家侄子到底是怎么走的，若是被人杀了，那等不可放过！
“没事，不说这些了，我们喝酒。”男子笑了起来，将自己手中的酒一口喝下。
“师兄！”忆无情的语气严肃起来：“能告诉我吗，他不止是你的儿子，也是我的侄子。”
男子沉默了一会，才缓缓道：“他爱上了一位无法触及的存在，那人的身份背景无比强大，就算是寒月宫也与那方势力在伯仲之间，更何况是我们凌天宗。”
“什么势力？”忆无情问道。
“九天帝朝。”
忆无情：“……”
“当年他与寒月宫一同去参加九天帝朝的立储典礼，对那位储君一见钟情，从此便对她念念不忘，他想追求那位储君，但都无用，他实力太弱，连见那位一面都不行。”
“但他是个倔脾气，非那位储君不可了，他当时与我这样说，无情叔能与寒月宫的圣女成为知己，那我一定也能与九天帝朝的储君成为道侣！”
“自那以后他就一直在九天帝朝努力修炼，想与引起那位储君的关注，他也很争气，很快便在九天帝朝打响名声，成为远近闻名的天骄，他在一场九天帝朝皇室所开展的大会中获得冠军，九天帝朝可以答应他一个条件。”
“他的条件师弟你是不是以为是见一面那位储君，但我还是小看了他的胆量，他竟直接放话要娶储君。”男子语气无奈，恨铁不成钢。
“那位储君是不是叫凤凝霜？”忆无情开口问道。
“对。”男子看向忆无情，笑道：“当我知道你在秘境中败了她得到第一，别提有多兴奋了，也是那时候我知道了你还活着，真好。”
“我侄子叫什么名字？”忆无情问道。
男子大笑一声：“我忆绝的儿子名字肯定响亮，叫忆霸天！”
忆无情：“……”
“那霸……霸天到底是谁害的。”
忆绝望向天际，笑道：“他的死都是他自己的错，不怪任何人，当年那位储君亲自出现了，让霸天接她一掌她在考虑霸天的条件，不然就直接滚。”
“霸天他没撑住？”忆无情眼神微冷，若是如此的话，那凤凝霜那疯女人日后自己定要去找她麻烦，哪怕这些是忆霸天他自作自受。

谁叫忆霸天是自家人呢。
忆绝摇摇头：“他撑住了，但也已经昏迷不醒，储君没有理会他，直接离开了，他的朋友带他去到客栈恢复伤势了，但他在恢复期间被人下杀手……”
说到这，忆绝双眸有些湿润，他在一万岁之时终于有了自己的孩子，但却走在他的面前，就像当年的师弟，也是走在了他前面。
虽然后来他知道了师弟没死。
“是凤凝霜吗？”忆无情眸光幽幽，不知在想什么。
“不知，我们查不出来，当年我请弟妹亲自去了一趟，但还是没有找到什么线索。”忆绝道。
“弟妹？”忆无情一愣。
“当然是冷宫主啊，人家若不是喜欢你，怎么会对你这么好，在你走后一直照顾着我们凌天宗，你可不能辜负人家。”忆绝神情严肃。
“定不负她。”忆无情微微一笑。
content_en:
"How did my nephew leave..." Yi Qingqing looked at his senior brother and said seriously.
He wants to know how his nephew left. If he is killed, he will not let him go!
"It's okay, let's not talk about this anymore, let's drink." The man laughed and drank the wine in his hand.
"Senior brother!" Yi Wuqing's tone became serious: "Can you tell me, he is not only your son, but also my nephew."
The man was silent for a while, then slowly said: "He fell in love with an untouchable being. That person's identity and background are extremely powerful. Even Hanyue Palace is on par with that force, let alone our Lingtian Sect."
"What force?" Yi Qingqing asked.
"The Nine Heavens Emperor Dynasty."
Yi Qingqing: "..."
"Back then, he and Hanyue Palace went to attend the ceremony of establishing the crown prince of the Jiutian Emperor. He fell in love with the crown prince at first sight, and he has been thinking about her ever since. He wanted to pursue the crown prince, but it was useless. He was too weak and could not even meet the crown prince."
"But he has a stubborn temper, and it must be the prince. He told me at that time that if Uncle Qingqing can become a close friend with the saint of Hanyue Palace, then I will definitely be able to become a Taoist companion with the prince of Jiutian Emperor!"
"Since then, he has been practicing hard in the Jiutian Imperial Dynasty, hoping to attract the attention of the prince. He is also very competitive. He quickly made a name for himself in the Jiutian Imperial Dynasty and became a well-known genius. He won the championship in a competition held by the Jiutian Imperial Dynasty royal family. The Jiutian Imperial Dynasty can agree to one condition for him."
"His conditions, junior brother, did you think he was going to meet the prince, but I still underestimated his courage. He actually directly said that he wanted to marry the prince." The man said in a helpless tone, hating that iron cannot be transformed into steel.
"Is that prince's name Feng Ningshuang?" Yi Qingqing asked.
"Yes." The man looked at Yi Qingqing and smiled: "When I knew that you defeated her in the secret realm and got first place, not to mention how excited I was. It was also at that time that I knew that you were still alive. It's great."
"What's my nephew's name?" Yi Qingqing asked.
The man laughed loudly: "My Yi Jue's son must have a resounding name, Yi Batian!"
Yi Qingqing: "..."
"Naha...who harmed Ba Tian?"
Yi looked to Tianji in despair and said with a smile: "His death is all his own fault. Don't blame anyone. The prince showed up in person and asked Batian to slap her. She was considering Batian's conditions, otherwise she would just get out."
"Ba Tian didn't hold on?" Yi Wuqing's eyes were slightly cold. If that was the case, then that crazy woman Feng Ningshuang would definitely go to her to cause trouble in the future, even if it was Yi Ba Tian who brought all this on himself.
Who said Yi Batian is one of his own family?
Yijue shook his head: "He held on, but he was already unconscious. The prince ignored him and left directly. His friend took him to the inn to recover from his injuries, but he was killed while he was recovering..."
Speaking of this, Yijue's eyes were a little moist. He finally had his own child when he was ten thousand years old, but he walked in front of him, just like his junior brother back then, who also walked in front of him.
Although he later found out that his junior brother was not dead.
"Is it Feng Ningshuang?" Yi Qingqing's eyes were dim and she didn't know what she was thinking.
"I don't know, we can't find out. I asked my younger siblings to go there in person, but we still didn't find any clues." Yi Jue said.
"Brother and sister?" Yi Qingqing was stunned.
"Of course it's Palace Master Leng. If they didn't like you, why would they be so kind to you? They've been taking care of our Lingtian Sect since you left. You can't let them down." Yijue looked serious.
"I will definitely live up to her." Yi Qingqing smiled slightly.
